text.description_html:
Fusion PH-E2, Blacksmith Wall Mounted Toilet Paper Holder

The Blacksmith Toilet Paper Holder has a southwest style that fits perfectly among the most popular design trends of recent years. It is available in antique copper, antique pewter, or oil rubbed bronze finishes. Easy to install, this toilet tissue holder can be mounted to hang in either direction.

Also Available Matching: Fusion TB-E2 Blacksmith Towel Bar, Fusion TR-E2 Blacksmith Towel Ring, and Fusion RH-E2 Blacksmith Robe Hook

Features and Specifications of the Fusion Blacksmith Collection Toilet Paper Holder:

  • Mount Length: 4"
  • Mount Width: 2-3/4"
  • Reversible to hang in either direction.
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
